title: Lighting
note: Lighting pack (tools/make_lighting_assets.py). The lights themselves are the usual `lights` list; the size comes from the universal _base_dimensions schema.

lighting_kind.label: Piece
lighting_kind.note: Which fixture: ceiling_flush, ceiling_pendant, chandelier, ceiling_fan, track_light, wall_sconce, vanity_bar, picture_light, swing_arm, wall_lantern, barn_light, flood_light, post_lamp, pole_light, bollard or path_light.

finish.label: Finish
finish.note: The metal: brass, bronze, black, white (classic) or chrome, black, nickel, white (modern).

mount.label: Mount
mount.note: Hangs from the ceiling, mounts on an inside or an outside wall, or stands on the ground.
